snippet.title: Timberborn - One More 1.0 Thing
snippet.description:
⏱️ Timberborn 1.0 brings bzzz bzzz zzzt bzzz.

Read more:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062090/view/526491913334818793

-- About Timberborn --
Humans are long gone. In a world struck by droughts and toxic waste, will your lumberpunk beavers do any better? A sandbox city-building game featuring ingenious animals, vertical architecture, water physics, and terraforming. Contains high amounts of wood.

-- Features --
🦫 Two unique beaver factions
💦 Droughts and waves of toxic waste
🧨 3D water physics with dams and floodgates
⛰️ Fully terraformable maps
🏡 Vertical settlements  
🪓 Lumberpunk machinery and bots
🌇 Day and night cycle
🥕 Well-being mechanics
🗾 Map editor and mods
